question: What is the reference price and margin for maize here?

sources: yield: 210.0 bu/acre, Iowa 2025; USDA NASS, Crop Production 2025 Summary (https://release.nass.usda.gov/reports/cropan26.txt)
price: $4.10/bu; USDA NASS, Crop Values 2025 Summary, marketing-year price (https://release.nass.usda.gov/reports/cpvl0226.txt)

cost: variable costs $483.60/acre for corn following soybeans at 211 bu/acre (total incl. land and labour $911.98/acre); Iowa State University Extension, Ag Decision Maker A1-20, Estimated Costs of Crop Production in Iowa 2026 (https://www.extension.iastate.edu/agdm/crops/pdf/a1-20.pdf)

yield.basis: Reference yield (Iowa (grain), 2026) x expected fraction 100 %; range between the poorest and the best tenth of the analysed years.

sources.name: Astrovivu reference economics, region US-HEARTLAND (docs/ECONOMICS.md): yield: 210.0 bu/acre, Iowa 2025; USDA NASS, Crop Production 2025 Summary (https://release.nass.usda.gov/reports/cropan26.txt); price: $4.10/bu; USDA NASS, Crop Values 2025 Summary, marketing-year price (https://release.nass.usda.gov/reports/cpvl0226.txt); cost: variable costs $483.60/acre for corn following soybeans at 211 bu/acre (total incl. land and labour $911.98/acre); Iowa State University Extension, Ag Decision Maker A1-20, Estimated Costs of Crop Production in Iowa 2026 (https://www.extension.iastate.edu/agdm/crops/pdf/a1-20.pdf)
sources.licence: Each figure keeps the terms of its publisher, named in the source line

caveats: Source quality: yield official (a statistics agency); price official (a statistics agency); cost budget (a university enterprise budget). Reference values, not this grower's figures, and not a forecast.

answer:
The reference price for maize in the US-Heartland region (Iowa) is 161.4 USD per tonne, based on USDA NASS 2025 marketing-year price figures [S1].

For this 29.25-hectare parcel, using a reference yield of 13.18 t/ha (based on Iowa 2025 USDA NASS figures at 100% expected yield) and a total cost of 34,954 USD (based on Iowa State University Extension 2026 enterprise budgets), the estimated revenue is 62,222 USD and the margin is 27,268 USD [S1]. 

These are reference values from official statistics and university budgets, not the grower's own figures [S1].
